description: This file defines the HeaderFooterRenderer class responsible for rendering headers and footers into RTF format within the MigraDoc document rendering library. It includes methods for rendering content, determining control words based on page setup, and setting rendering context properties.

classes.name: HeaderFooterRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders header or footer sections into RTF format, handling different page setups and rendering contexts.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders a single header or footer by writing control words and rendering contained elements.

methods.name: GetHeaderFooterControls
methods.description: Determines the appropriate RTF control words for the header or footer based on page setup and rendering context.
